.sky_zero
{
    LDX #0
.row
    STX sky_q
    JSR sky_row
    BNE cell
.whole                              \ A = 0 (sky_row left sky_skip, and Z is set)
    STA (s_ptr),Y
    DEY
    STA (s_ptr),Y
    DEY
    BPL whole
    BMI next_row                    \ (always)
candidates.summary: sky_draw.next_row: INX straight on X (still the row; LDX sky_q reloaded it), 3 cycles and 2 bytes less. sky_zero: drop the redundant LDA #0 (A is sky_skip = 0 when BNE cell falls through) and unroll the whole-row zeroing by 2. One EQUB pad keeps the code after (and so sky_img0, &317F) where it was. Alternative to the other candidates (overlaps them).
candidates.equivalence: sky_draw.next_row is reached only from the tail, from `BMI next_row` after the whole-row loop, and by fall-through; on all X is the row index: sky_row (LDA/STA/EOR/SEC/ADC/ORA/TAY/LDA, RTS) never writes X, and neither the h0/rc_ok code, `part`, the cell JMP or the eight LDA/STA/DEY lines. Nothing else enters the label (grep next_row: sky_draw's scope only). sky_q is still stored by `STX sky_q` at row, so its value at exit is the same as before (the last row, which the old reload did not change). At the exit (BEQ done) X = nq, C=1, Z=1, A and Y unchanged: as before. The row loop `JMP row` re-enters with X = row + 1 exactly as the old LDX/INX gave. sky_zero's whole path: BNE cell not taken means Z=1 from the LDA sky_skip at the end of sky_row, so A = 0 and LDA #0 only repeated it; STA (s_ptr),Y/DEY twice per BPL writes the same bytes in the same order as the one-per-loop code provided Y+1 is even at entry, and a whole row (skip = 0, n = 8, rt = 7, ry = 8 * a column) has Y = 8 * columns - 1 + ... i.e. Y+1 a multiple of 8, the same fact sky_draw's own 4x unrolled whole loop already relies on. Loop exit is the same (Y goes negative after an even count, BPL not taken, BMI next_row always). Registers live out of sky_zero whole path: A=0, X=row, Y negative - unchanged.
candidates.relies_on: Net size 0: -2 (LDX sky_q) -2 (LDA #0) +3 (extra STA/DEY) +1 pad, so no code or data after the window moves (sky_img0 stays at its address: the (d_ptr),Y page crossings of the image reads are untouched; hot BPL cell/JMP cell and line8 are before the edit). Inside the window sky_zero's labels shift by 0 to -1 byte but stay inside one page (page &31 in the shipping build); the only branches there (BPL whole, BMI next_row, BPL cell, BNE row) are short and cannot newly cross. The hot tail (TYA..BPL cell) and `cell`/line8 are above the edit and do not move. Relies on: X preserved by sky_row and the cell code in sky_draw; A=0 from sky_row when Z set; whole rows have Y+1 a multiple of 2 (in fact 8).
